units.source_text: 男人用衬衫袖子擦擦汗，说话口气里充满了好意。

en.t: The man wiped his sweat with his shirt sleeve, and his tone of voice was full of goodwill.

units.source_text: 青年们对他的帮忙，谁也没说一句戏言，只是一个劲儿利索地干活。

en.t: None of the young men made even a single joke about his help; they simply kept working briskly and efficiently.
He felt warmly disposed toward the young men.
